meta.name: list-growth-designer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "grow my email list", "design a lead magnet / signup incentive", "set up double opt-in", or "plan a referral / recommendation loop"; produces a list-growth plan — acquisition channels, lead-magnet / incentive concepts, a compliant double-opt-in capture-flow spec, referral-loop mechanics, and subscriber-growth / cost-per-opt-in targets (labeled Estimated) — that feeds SEND-S (consent quality captured at acquisition) and SEND-N (lifecycle entry). Not for the signup page/popup UX itself — use landing-optimizer; not for recording the opt-in — use consent-registry; not for the confirmation-email copy — use email-creative-builder. 邮件列表增长/lead magnet/双重确认/推荐环

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计邮件列表增长方案，包括引流诱饵和推荐机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地扩大邮件订阅者并提升获客效率。
copy.tagline_en: Design an email list growth plan with lead magnets and referral loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically grow your email subscriber base and improve acquisition efficiency.

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你制定一份邮件列表增长计划，包括获取渠道、免费赠品/激励方案、合规的双重确认流程、推荐循环机制，以及订阅者增长和每次获取成本的目标。它只负责策略设计，不制作注册页面或确认邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求“增长我的邮件列表”、“设计一个免费赠品/注册激励”、“设置双重确认”或“规划一个推荐/推荐循环”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个针对健身爱好者的免费电子书作为注册激励。
say.note: 技能会产出免费赠品概念和获取渠道建议。

say.text: 为我的新闻通讯设置一个双重确认流程，受众是科技创业者。
say.note: 技能会指定确认流程和需要收集的同意证据。

say.text: 规划一个推荐循环，当前列表有5000人，主要来自博客。
say.note: 技能会设计推荐机制和增长目标。

howto.what_en: This skill produces a list-growth plan including acquisition channels, lead magnet/incentive concepts, a compliant double-opt-in capture flow, referral loop mechanics, and subscriber growth/cost-per-opt-in targets. It designs strategy only, not signup pages or confirmation emails.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "grow my email list", "design a lead magnet / signup incentive", "set up double opt-in", or "plan a referral / recommendation loop".

say_en.text: Design a lead magnet (free ebook) for fitness enthusiasts.
say_en.note: Skill outputs incentive concept and channel suggestions.

say_en.text: Set up a double opt-in flow for my newsletter targeting tech founders.
say_en.note: Skill specifies flow and consent evidence to capture.

say_en.text: Plan a referral loop for my 5000-subscriber list from blog.
say_en.note: Skill designs referral mechanics and growth targets.
